images.action_name: 腕尺偏／桡偏轻负荷控制
images.label: 中立位
images.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE photorealistic rehabilitation exercise demonstration photo, landscape 1536x1024. The three input photos are identity, wardrobe, skin tone, studio lighting and gray-blue background references only. Match the same adult East Asian woman with black ponytail, white short-sleeve T-shirt and dark gray trousers. Do not copy the raised-arm pose.
Action 178 / T-AXU-037, frame s01: neutral wrist position for radial/ulnar deviation. She is seated beside a stable plain matte light-gray table. Her RIGHT elbow and whole RIGHT forearm rest firmly on the tabletop, right upper arm close to torso, elbow bent around 90 degrees. Forearm runs horizontally from the left side of the picture toward the right table edge. The wrist is just beyond the edge, right hand empty and unsupported beyond the edge. Right hand is in a thumb-up handshake orientation: palm plane vertical, thumb on upper edge, little finger on lower edge. Four fingers together, naturally relaxed and mostly extended, one thumb, exactly five anatomically correct digits. Hand and forearm longitudinal axes are aligned horizontally in neutral, neither upward nor downward deviation.
Camera: close view perpendicular to the VERTICAL radial/ulnar deviation plane, from the palm-facing side with a slight front angle so palm, thumb side and little-finger side can be distinguished. Include right elbow, full supported forearm, complete wrist and fingertips, tabletop and its real edge; include a modest part of the woman's white-shirt torso at left as body reference. The exercise arm dominates the frame, avoid a remote wide shot. Natural adult limb lengths and continuous wrist anatomy. Soft diffuse photographic studio light, gray-blue seamless background, same visual treatment as references, natural skin texture and table contact shadow. Moderate blank background above the arm. Do not include dumbbells or any device. No text, no numbers, no arrows, no inset, no collage, no watermark. Exactly one still pose.

image_review.details: 右手空手，拇指在上、小指在下，四指自然并拢；手与前臂长轴水平延续。右肘和完整前臂在同一桌面支持，腕和手在桌边外；手背面和各指轮廓可辨。局部近景包括邻近肘和躯干参照。五指连续，无多指/断腕；无文字箭头或拼图。
image_review.method: 逐张 view_image 视觉审查

images.group_review: 已独立逐张查看：中立、向拇指侧上桡偏、向小指侧下尺偏区分清晰；相机、桌面和前臂支持一致。

images.action_name: 腕尺偏／桡偏轻负荷控制
images.label: 向拇指侧桡偏
images.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Edit this one rehabilitation wrist demonstration photograph into frame 178 / T-AXU-037 s02. Preserve the exact same woman, identity, clothes, chair, table, tabletop edge, forearm position, elbow contact, torso, lighting, gray-blue background, photographic realism, camera crop and image dimensions. Change ONLY the right hand angle at the wrist.
The supported right forearm stays horizontal and exactly still on the table. The empty right hand remains in thumb-up orientation with the thumb side above and little-finger side below; keep its currently visible dorsal surface facing the camera without rotating the forearm.
At the wrist, move the whole hand gently about 15 degrees UPWARD toward its THUMB side, producing small RADIAL DEVIATION, so the four fingers and hand longitudinal axis now slope slightly upward to the right. The thumb rotates with the hand. Fingers retain the same relaxed together pose and same lengths, exactly four fingers plus one thumb. The wrist pivot stays at the same point just beyond the table edge. Anatomically gentle, continuous wrist contours, no extra flexion or extension, no pronation or supination, no raised elbow or forearm.
This is one single still photo. No text, numbers, arrows, inset, collage, watermark or device.

images.prompt:

images.label: 中立，拇指向上
images.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Asset type: one photorealistic rehabilitation exercise step photo, action 179 T-AXU-038, neutral forearm rotation.
Input images: the three supplied images are identity, clothing, studio photography and gray-blue backdrop references only. They do not define the exercise pose.
Make one new single-pose photograph of exactly the same East Asian adult woman as the references: same face and age, natural skin, black ponytail, plain white short-sleeve tee and dark charcoal gray trousers. Soft studio lighting and seamless gray-blue background, natural shadows, no graphics.

She is seated upright beside a simple stable pale-gray rehabilitation table, facing toward image-right. Her anatomical RIGHT arm is the near arm. Right upper arm hangs vertically beside her torso; right elbow is bent approximately 90 degrees and visibly rests on the table close to her body. The proximal right forearm lies on the tabletop for clear support; the forearm extends horizontally forward toward image-right, with her wrist and hand slightly beyond the front table edge. The entire forearm and wrist stay straight in a neutral alignment. Her empty right hand is in the neutral forearm position, thumb side UP like a relaxed handshake; fingers are softly extended forward together, palm vertical rather than facing up or down. No fist, no weight or rod. Thumb visible distinctly above fingers. Left hand rests naturally on her left thigh and cannot obscure the right arm.

Camera: front-right oblique medium close-up from the woman's anatomical right side, enough front angle to see the near right elbow, forearm, complete wrist and palm/thumb direction clearly. Frame her complete head, torso and upper thighs with dark trousers showing, plus full right hand and tabletop supporting the elbow/forearm. Arms neither oversized nor foreshortened; natural proportions. Right arm must be visually unmistakable and physically connected. Leave modest clear space near the hand. No split screen or collage.
Constraints: single still pose; anatomically correct five-finger right hand; wrist neutral with no flexion, extension or side bending; elbow truly contacting the table; shoulder relaxed and upper arm close to trunk. No text, numbers, captions, arrows, motion trails, watermarks, extra people or floating objects.

images.label: 旋后，掌心向上
images.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Edit target: the supplied rehabilitation exercise photograph.
Create the second separate step photo for forearm supination by making ONLY this anatomical pose change: rotate the woman's RIGHT forearm around its unchanged horizontal long axis until the RIGHT PALM FACES UPWARD toward the ceiling. Clearly show the softly extended fingers and natural palm creases facing upward; the thumb now lies naturally to the woman's outward/right side of the hand. The back of the hand faces the tabletop. Fingertips keep pointing image-right. This is an empty hand, no object. It is forearm axial supination, not wrist bending. The wrist remains straight and exactly in line with the forearm, no extension/flexion or side deviation.

Keep the original right elbow resting at the same place on the tabletop, right upper arm close to the torso, elbow flexion approximately 90 degrees, shoulder down, forearm horizontal and supported on the same tabletop along its proximal portion. Don't move the elbow, shoulder, chest, head or whole arm to achieve the palm rotation. Maintain the same arm length and hand size, anatomical five fingers.
Preserve EXACTLY the same woman, face, ponytail, white short sleeve tee, dark gray trousers, seated torso position, left hand on thigh, chair, table shape and height and location, gray-blue backdrop, soft light, camera position, crop and subject scale from the target. Complete hand stays visible. Same single portrait composition and one pose only. No text, numbering, arrows, motion trails, captions, watermark or collage.
images.image_review: 通过逐张 view_image 审查：由中立图作同机位编辑，人物、桌椅、躯干、上臂及肘接触位置与 s01 保持；右掌面与掌纹朝上，旋后方向清楚，手指自然，腕无额外明显侧偏；肘和近侧前臂保持支持，没有肩带动整臂翻转。照片是静态终点，旋转过程须后续步骤说明。

images.label: 旋前，掌心向下
images.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Edit target: the supplied rehabilitation exercise photograph with an upright thumb (the neutral starting frame).
Create the third separate step photo for forearm pronation by making ONLY this anatomical pose change: rotate the woman's anatomical RIGHT forearm around its unchanged horizontal long axis until the RIGHT PALM FACES DOWNWARD toward the tabletop and the BACK OF THE RIGHT HAND faces upward toward the ceiling. Four fingers softly extended forward together toward image-right, their dorsal knuckles and fingernails naturally visible from slightly above; thumb lies naturally at the inner/medial side of the hand. Empty hand with no tool. Keep the wrist straight, exactly in line with the forearm, no extra wrist flexion, extension or side bending. The hand lies nearly horizontal, hovering naturally just above the table or lightly touching it. This is a clear pronation endpoint opposite to palm-up supination, achieved by axial forearm rotation alone.

Keep the original right elbow at exactly the same tabletop contact place near her body, right upper arm close to torso, right elbow bent approximately 90 degrees, shoulder down, forearm horizontal and visibly supported along the same table. Do not swing the entire arm or turn the shoulder/chest to achieve palm down. Maintain the same arm length and hand size; anatomically correct five fingers.
Preserve EXACTLY the same woman, face, ponytail, white tee, dark gray trousers, seated torso posture, left hand on thigh, chair, stable table shape/height/position, gray-blue background, soft studio lighting, camera and crop, subject scale as the supplied target. Complete hand stays visible. Same single portrait photograph, one pose only, no text, numbering, arrows, motion trails, captions, watermark or collage.

images.action_name: 固定高台手掌承重转移
images.label: 高台支持起始位
images.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: one raw rehabilitation exercise demonstration photograph, action 180 T-AXU-039, step s01. Input images: the three provided reference photos are identity, clothing, studio lighting, and gray-blue background references only; do not copy their poses or cropping. Subject: exactly the same East Asian adult woman with black ponytail, same face, skin tone and natural slim build, wearing a plain white short-sleeve T-shirt and dark charcoal long trousers. Create one photorealistic studio photograph, no collage. A sturdy fixed rectangular high support table approximately waist height stands to the woman's right in the image; thick plain light-gray tabletop and stable dark-gray legs, no wheels. Woman faces right, camera is true side with a very slight front oblique angle so BOTH forearms, palms and feet are visible. Show her entire head, both shoulders, elbows, wrists, complete fingers, body and complete bare feet, floor and support table. This is the LOW INITIAL LOAD support position: both palms flat on the tabletop near its left edge, shoulder-width apart, fingers naturally spread and pointing forward over the table; wrists naturally extended, both elbows nearly straight without locking. Her body is fairly upright with a modest forward lean as one aligned head-trunk-hips line, shoulders relaxed. Both feet are flat on the floor at hip-width, a short distance back from the table, heels firmly down, knees soft, stable. The feet are close enough to permit a small forward body weight shift later without lifting them. Tabletop approximately level with her waist, hands below shoulders. Frame as a clear side-view near full-body medical teaching photo, landscape 3:2 composition with generous safe margins and natural realistic anatomy. Soft even studio lighting, clean matte gray-blue seamless wall and floor, subtle natural shadows. One static pose only. No text, numbers, arrows, logos, watermark, labels or colored instructional marks. Avoid bent-elbow push-up pose, deep leaning plank, knees on ground, foot lift, floating fingers, obscured hand contacts, cropped feet.
images.image_review: 逐张 view_image 审查通过。女性人物、白短袖深灰长裤、灰蓝棚拍背景与参考一致；头、双手腕肘肩、全脚与台面完整可见；双掌真实贴稳固定腰高台面，手指自然分开；双脚全掌落地，近直肘，身体较直，符合低初始负荷支持姿态。手部略有侧面重叠但两手掌、腕与前臂可辨。
images.group_review: 已独立逐张查看：双手双脚支点和台面保持；第二图上身小幅靠近台面，肘近直，双脚跟落地。

images.action_name: 固定高台手掌承重转移
images.label: 保持支点，小幅前移
images.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: raw rehabilitation photograph action 180 T-AXU-039 step s02. Edit target: the provided photograph is the accepted s01 start pose. Make ONLY the small controlled forward body weight shift toward the supporting hands. Preserve the exact woman and facial identity, black ponytail, white short-sleeve T-shirt, dark charcoal trousers, camera angle, 3:2 framing, person scale, background, soft studio lighting, floor, fixed waist-high table and all its legs. BOTH palms and every fingertip must remain at EXACTLY the same tabletop positions. BOTH complete bare feet, heels and toes must remain at EXACTLY the same floor positions, both soles flat, no foot slide or lift. Change only her connected head-neck-shoulders-trunk-pelvis pose by a modest controlled forward lean toward her palms: shoulders and chest advance approximately 8 cm toward the right (toward the table), the upper body comes visibly a little closer to the table, hips follow naturally a little forward. Keep the body fairly aligned and relatively upright; this is a small weight transfer, not a deep incline plank. Crucially BOTH elbows must remain ALMOST FULLY STRAIGHT, with no bent-elbow push-up. Arms rotate naturally slightly closer to vertical as shoulders move forward above the fixed hands. Small knee softness is permissible while feet stay fixed; do not squat. Head stays neutral with the trunk, no shrug, no back arch. Keep wrist and palm contact anatomically natural, fingers spread. Entire head, both shoulders, elbows, wrists, all fingers, both complete feet and table contacts remain visible. Exactly one static pose. No text, arrows, numbers, labels, collage, watermark or logos. Do not change table height, support locations, clothing, bare feet, lighting, camera or crop.
images.image_review: 逐张 view_image 审查通过，并与 s01 对照。相机、背景、台面、人物服装尺度、双掌及双脚支点保持；肩胸与躯干小幅向手侧前移，上身靠近支持台面；双肘仍基本伸直，未画成俯卧撑；双脚脚跟仍落地、未跪地；全身与手脚、关节和支撑接触完整可见。
images.group_review: 已独立逐张查看：双手双脚支点和台面保持；第二图上身小幅靠近台面，肘近直，双脚跟落地。

images.label: 中立握双臂起始位
images.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Asset type: a single photorealistic rehabilitation exercise demonstration photograph, action 181 T-AXU-059 hammer curl, start posture s01.
Input images 1, 2, 3 are ONLY identity/clothing/photographic-style/background references. Recompose the same East Asian adult woman, preserve her face, age, skin tone, natural body shape, black ponytail, plain white short-sleeve T-shirt and dark charcoal long trousers.
Scene: clean seamless soft gray-blue studio background and floor, gentle studio lighting and subtle natural shadows, no clutter.
Compose a vertical near-full-body photograph of the woman at a front three-quarter oblique angle, head and both complete feet fully visible, both elbows wrists hands and dumbbells unobstructed. Camera at lower chest height with natural proportions, enough separation to see both arms. Small staggered stance, both feet planted securely, upright neutral trunk, head forward, shoulders relaxed.
Exact posture: starting position of a bilateral simultaneous neutral-grip HAMMER CURL. Both upper arms close against her sides, elbows nearly extended comfortably; each hand holds one identical small lightweight matte-gray dumbbell beside the thigh. Both palms face INWARD toward the body, thumbs oriented forward/up naturally with knuckles outward; the two dumbbell handle axes run front-to-back in the sagittal plane, NOT left-to-right like a supinated curl. Hands wrap securely around handles, wrist straight and aligned with forearm. Dumbbells clear of thigh so neutral grip is visibly readable.
No curled arm in this first photograph. No text, labels, numbers, arrows, panels, watermark or logo. One woman, one pose, two dumbbells, natural connected anatomy and five fingers on each hand. Keep photographic realism of the references. Footwear: plain low-profile light-gray athletic shoes, unchanged for the matching end image.
images.image_review: 小分腿站稳，双脚完整可见；同款轻哑铃分别置于体侧，掌心向内中立握；上臂近体侧，腕自然；人物服装与灰蓝棚拍背景符合参考。
images.group_review: 已独立逐张查看：双手中立握，起点与同步屈肘终点区分清晰；上臂近体侧，无明显仰腰，脚位和器械一致。

images.label: 同步屈肘锤式弯举
images.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: single photorealistic rehabilitation demonstration photograph, action 181 T-AXU-059 hammer curl END posture s02.
Input image 1 is the precise edit target/start image. Edit ONLY the flexion of both elbows and consequent position of the forearms, hands and dumbbells. Preserve the identical woman, face, black ponytail, skin, white T-shirt, dark charcoal trousers, light gray sneakers, exact foot placement/stagger, body proportions, neutral upright torso, shoulders, upper arms close to sides, background, floor, shadows, camera position, lens, image crop, scale, and the two identical compact gray dumbbells.
Required end posture: BOTH elbows flex simultaneously to approximately 95–105 degrees. Upper arms stay vertically close to the ribcage in the SAME position. Both forearms incline modestly upward in front of the lower ribs, hands roughly in front of the lower chest, elbows below the hands. BOTH wrists remain straight, with neutral HAMMER grip: palms STILL face each other inward toward the body midline, no supination, thumbs uppermost on the grips, backs of hands facing laterally. The handles/long axes of both dumbbells should now be near vertical, as expected when hammer-curl elbows are flexed, with one weight head above and one below each wrapped hand. Two hands and two identical dumbbells visibly separated and fully readable. No raising elbows/shoulders, no upper-arm forward swing, no trunk sway or back arch.
Anatomy realistic: connected natural elbows and wrists, five fingers per hand gripping the handles naturally. Exactly one subject and one posture. No text, numbers, arrows, panels, watermark, logo. Keep all scene invariants, feet planted, full head and both feet within frame.
images.image_review: 双肘同步屈曲，双掌仍向内，哑铃轴近竖直呈锤式握法；上臂近体侧、躯干直立无明显仰腰；脚位、相机、服装器材与s01一致。
images.group_review: 已独立逐张查看：双手中立握，起点与同步屈肘终点区分清晰；上臂近体侧，无明显仰腰，脚位和器械一致。
